from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path('D:/repos/wright')
local = root / '.local-run/process-interfaces-083'
node = 'node'
checks = [
    ('client-types', [node, str(root / 'node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc'), '--project',
                     str(root / 'packages/process_client/tsconfig.json'), '--noEmit'], root),
    ('test-types', [node, str(root / 'node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc'), '--noEmit',
                    '--module', 'esnext', '--moduleResolution', 'bundler', '--target', 'es2023',
                    '--lib', 'ES2023,DOM,DOM.Iterable', '--strict', '--skipLibCheck',
                    'src/services/surfaces/process-presentation.spec.ts'], root / 'apps/web'),
    ('client-tests', [node, str(root / 'node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs'), 'run',
                     'src/services/surfaces/process-presentation.spec.ts', 'src/services/process-client.spec.ts',
                     '--maxWorkers=1', '--reporter=dot'], root / 'apps/web'),
]
code = 0
for name, argv, cwd in checks:
    with (local / ('t037-' + name + '-final.log')).open('w', encoding='utf-8') as log:
        process = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=cwd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                   text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
        for line in process.stdout:
            log.write(line)
            log.flush()
            print(line, end='', flush=True)
        result = process.wait()
        log.write(f'\nowned_exit_code={result}\n')
        code = max(code, result)
sys.exit(code)
